## Acceptance
- [ ] Required implementation or evidence exists
- [ ] Synthetic negative controls included when relevant
- [ ] Exact test commands and observed outputs attached (public-safe)
- [ ] Confidential artifacts omitted
- [ ] Independent review complete
- [ ] Upstream interfaces and docs updated only if needed

## Handoff
Actual branch/commit, changed files, tests/failed tests, model/evidence provenance, blockers and next task. A claim or green CI does not equal acceptance.
